lines.text: A town called Boring teamed up with a village called Dull.

parts.tts: A town called Boring teamed up with a village called Dull.
parts.heard: A town called Boring teamed up with a village called Dull.

lines.note: retaken (seed 3) and spliced: the first take read "Dull" as "Do"

lines.text: These are real places. Boring is in Oregon. Its motto: the most exciting place to live.

parts.tts: These are real places. Boring is in Oregon. Its motto: the most exciting place to live.
parts.heard: These are real places. Boring is in Oregon. It's Motto, the most exciting place to live.

lines.text: Dull is in Scotland. Population: about 84.

parts.tts: Dull is in Scotland. Population: about eighty-four.
parts.heard: Dull is in Scotland, population about 84.

lines.text: In 2012, a Scottish woman on a cycling holiday rode through Boring... and had an idea.

parts.tts: In twenty twelve, a Scottish woman on a cycling holiday rode through Boring...
parts.heard: In 2012, a Scottish woman on a cycling holiday rode through Boring.

lines.text: Boring's planning group voted. Unanimous. Boring and Dull, a pair for the ages.

parts.tts: Boring's planning group voted. Unanimous. Boring and Dull, a pair for the ages.
parts.heard: Boring's planning group voted. Unanimous. Boring and Dull appear for the ages.

lines.text: But here's the part... now they throw a party. Boring and Dull Day, every August ninth.

parts.tts: now they throw a party. Boring and Dull Day, every August ninth.
parts.heard: Now they throw a party, boring and dull day, every August 9th.

lines.text: Then, in 2013, a third town joined. Bland. As in, Bland, Australia.

parts.tts: Then, in twenty thirteen, a third town joined. Bland. As in, Bland, Australia.
parts.heard: Then, in 2013, a third town joined, Bland, as in Bland, Australia.

lines.text: Together, they're the League of Extraordinary Communities.

parts.tts: Together, they're the League of Extraordinary Communities.
parts.heard: Together, they're the League of Extraordinary Communities.

lines.text: Also known as... the Trinity of Tedium.
